summary: Most faults are in the step pictures: a tiled dot grid in the lower sky (steps 1-3), a flat brushless snow fill (4-6), a vertical seam patch where the lantern will hang that persists from step 7 to 16, and two big jumps where one step restyles everything (step 7 remodels the whole snow field, step 19 finishes the brass lantern in one move). Where the words and pictures disagree on color, it's the last step of a part adding color it never names (white cap highlights in 16, bronze bars where the words say Deep night blue in 20). Placement is accurate throughout.
